title: Hero · composite photo (vertical-landing)
description: Hero for vertical-landings (Lorem Ipsum, Lorem Ipsum, Lorem Ipsum, etc). Left column: breadcrumb eyebrow, 3-line H1 with italic-blue accent, 2 lede paragraphs, CTA pair. Right column: 5:6 photo slot with overlays — dark stat chip (bottom-left) and two person cards (top-right). Photo defaults to a neutral striped media placeholder; replace via {{photo_url}} (IMAGE param).

source.adapted_from: v3 dark → light tokens. Photo slot generalized to IMAGE param so each vertical brings its own imagery.
source.decision: PM lock 2026-05-21 — vertical-landing hero pattern = composite-photo

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Full-width vertical hero background; separate from the main photo slot.
Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

notes: Photo slot [data-photo-slot] defaults to a neutral striped placeholder. In CMS, replace the placeholder with . CSS already covers img the same way it covers the placeholder.
Person card avatars are IMAGE slots too. If {{person_1_avatar_url}} or {{person_2_avatar_url}} is empty/#, the block keeps the circular fallback icon; when set, the image replaces that icon.
Overlays (chip + person cards) are absolute-positioned over the photo. Coordinates are in the CSS — at ≤980px they slide in slightly so they don't fall off the narrower art container.
At ≤540px the CTA pair stacks and each button stretches to the full content width.
Composes the canonical CTA pair (cta.btn-primary-ring + cta.btn-secondary-filled).
